pageTitle: Make a property possession claim online
heading: Make a property possession claim online
paragraphs: It costs £404 to make a claim. You can pay using a debit or credit card.
If you’re on a low income, have limited savings or are claiming benefits, you may be able to get help with your fee. Check if you can get help with fees (opens in new tab).
eligibilityIntro: You can use this service if:
bullets: you’re claiming possession of a property in England
afterBullets: We’ll ask some questions to check you’re eligible to use this service.

You cannot take court action to repossess a property if you’re told that someone is temporarily protected from creditors through the ‘Breathing Space’ scheme. Find out what to do when someone is using the ‘Breathing Space’ scheme (opens in new tab).
afterClaimHeading: What will happen after your claim is made
afterClaimText: A court hearing will be scheduled where a judge will decide whether to grant possession.
